theme.style: Warm editorial calm turned nocturnal: deep moss and forest greens layered like pressed paper, with a bloom of soft honey-gold light rising from the lower right as if from a low lamp. Cream typography sits against matte grain and fine paper tooth, evoking a quiet notebook kept by a window at dusk. Nothing shouts — the mood is patient, tended, and quietly luxurious, the way a long streak of small daily habits feels.
